requirements.title: EOSHIFT ARRAY, SHIFT, BOUNDARY, and DIM argument restrictions
requirements.definition: ARRAY shall be an array of any type; SHIFT shall be integer and scalar for rank-one ARRAY or scalar/rank n-1 with the required shape otherwise; BOUNDARY, when present, shall have ARRAY type and type parameters and scalar or the required rank n-1 shape; DIM shall be an integer scalar in range 1 through rank(ARRAY).
